self_introduction: I am an AI/ML Engineer | LLM Systems | Applied AI R&D. I am an AI/ML engineer with extensive production R&D experience building and deploying domain-specific AI systems. I am skilled in training and fine-tuning large models, developing LLM/RAG applications, model serving, and full-stack delivery.

I delivered FastAPI/Docker inference services with logging, metrics, and health monitoring. I contributed to the development and deployment of PetaPoly™ 4.0, an AI-driven drug discovery platform supporting internal research workflows. Frontend Developer, theOrigo, Mar 2019 – Feb 2021: I built responsive production web applications for government, education, healthcare, arts, and enterprise clients. I delivered public-facing websites and digital platforms for 1823, EdUHK, Hong Kong Philharmonic, CUHK Medical Clinic, and CUHK Medical Centre. I worked with designers, backend engineers, and stakeholders; I resolved production issues and supported reliable releases. Research Assistant, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Aug 2017 – Jun 2018: I conducted plant-genomics research using DNA/RNA extraction, PCR, and ChIP-seq under rigorous laboratory protocols.
